LanguageData.SSC_TrainerIdentity_MasterTip: Masters qualify as trainers. Training still requires suitable work settings and target permission.
LanguageData.SSC_TrainerIdentity_UnsetTip: A pawn without an identity cannot serve as a trainer. Masters qualify directly; sex slaves need Training Officer qualification.
LanguageData.SSC_TrainerIdentity_SlaveTip: Enable this after qualifying as a Training Officer. Losing qualification keeps this choice and assignments but suspends the role. Turning it off also keeps assignments and lets ongoing training finish. Work settings and target permission still apply.
LanguageData.SSC_TrainerIdentity_Failure_ChainStageTo: Requires the submissive sex slave chain stage
LanguageData.SSC_TrainerIdentity_Failure_FinalDisable: Final Training Officer state is currently disabled
LanguageData.SSC_TrainerIdentity_Failure_WrongSpecial: Training Officer is not the current specialization
LanguageData.SSC_TrainerIdentity_FinalDisabledPending: Conditions are restored; final effects will resume shortly
LanguageData.SSC_TrainerIdentity_RestrictionTip: Once selected, this specialization allows consensual and forced initiation while its ongoing conditions are met. The 20% threshold applies only to the trainer role. Global settings and rule priority still apply.
LanguageData.SSC_TrainerIdentity_Required: Requires a master or an active Training Officer.
LanguageData.SSC_TrainerWork_State_Away: Trainer is not a free colonist on this map
LanguageData.SSC_TrainerWork_CategoryTip: Enables Training at priority 3; keeps an existing priority. Includes eligible personality excretion and insertion tasks.
LanguageData.SSC_TrainerWork_Changed: The pawn, assignment or work settings changed. Reopen the menu.
LanguageData.SSC_TrainerWork_Failed: Could not complete the training work settings. Please try again.
